Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: Why has the Kia Seltos been called a donkey car in India?
Answer: Because of an aggrieved customer. The customer, found oil leakage in his brand new car and when asked for replacement of engine , the Kia Authorized Service station refused. On constant mail to Kia Motors, he couldn’t get reply. If you spent Rs. 1.9 Million on a brand new car and such happens, what would you do? He then used a trick used by another aggrieved customer of another Car Company, MG Hector: (MG Hector driven by a donkey) So what happened? Like MG , Kia offered solutions and extended some perks to the customer. Now next time you know what to do, if your car company refuses service. ;)

Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: How can I train myself to be less empathetic and to love myself first?
Answer: First of all, we should understand that we are not this body. Every part of our body is an independent individual having high level of intellect (this is as per yoga philosophy) and the same is proved by modern science as well in the form of “microbiomes”. We totally seem to ignore some of the most fundamental thing like breathing. We can breathe because our brain, our lungs, our heart, our kidneys our liver have been continuously functioning as a unit. Observe our breath how oir body is functioning together making us alive. Learning : You are not your whole body. Secondly, please always be empathetic, but be aware. The solution here is not being less empathetic but being more aware and conscious. For example; when someone hurts us, its sometimes better to teach them a lesson without any bitterness or anger rather with compassion, so that the person can learn a valuable lesson and can live a more fulfilled life. Most people tend to hurt us because of their own insecurities, we need to be aware of our own emotions, are we able to analyze the insecurities of the person trying to hurt us and are we capable of choosing the right treatment on the basis of their past history. For e.g., We just cannot give a lecture on bhagwad Geeta to a person trying to attack us physically, we need to have self defence first. Check if we are capable of doing so then we can take action , If not, it's their own karma, the result will have to be borne by the doer. There is a story of Buddha , when one person abused him , Buddhas disciples got angry but Buddha was all chill. After that person, stopped abusing, the disciples asked why are you not affected by his abuses. Buddha simply asked, if someone gifts us anything, and suppose you donot accept it, what would happen? Disciples said that the gift would be with the person that was trying to gift us. “Exactly!” Buddha said. If you donot accept the abuse, the abuse will be with the abuser and not with us. Learning : Be aware and conscious. Kindly analyze the above and you'll get your answer.

Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: I think I need a girlfriend to be happy. What should I do?
Answer: May God bless your to be girlfriend, because she will really need it. Being in a relationship is not to suck happiness out of the other person rather spreading your happiness and joy. In order to be in a relationship , first of all , we have to learn to love ourselves. We need to understand , happiness, joy, grief are our own choices. Because of the samskaaras (~accumulated experiences) and the inertia, it seems as if it’s an automatic process and feels we have no control over it, but with constant practice of awareness, we definitely know that it’s us who decides, whether we will be happy or miserable. It’s just like a workout, there is no magic pill. It’s pure work. Even if you get a girlfriend, you might be infatuated for some period of time but will gradually lose the interest, and you will look for happiness in others person, things etc. Please do not beg for happiness in others, look within, for everything is inside. Best wishes.

Name: CA. Suyog Upadhyaya
Question: How can I become fluent in English?
Answer: Here’s some practical & [ (secret ;) ] tips how a non-native English speaker like me became fluent in English : A bit of a background: I was born in Nepal and completed my schooling here. Although I was privileged enough to join an English school since I was a kid, I was very poor in English. In 6th standard I joined a new school and I felt kind of left out. Everyone used to watch English movies, listen to English songs and I couldn’t even understand a single word. Then in the first terminal examination, I got bad grades because of English Grammar. Then I decided, I will not let English take over my self-esteem. So what did I do? 1.Read a lot: I read a lot of English books. I started with very basic fairy tale stories. I used to speak out loud while reading so that I could get hang of the words. Of course I didn’t spell perfectly but it was worth the effort. Gradually moving to simple novels and newspapers. I really enjoyed reading books from the school library. You have the added benefit of reading here in Quora ;) 2. Speak a lot: I sought help from my brother as well, he was small kid back then, he probably doesn’t even remember us making this pact at home that we would speak in English. There were some cool friends as well, with whom I made this pact of speaking in English. Now, there are various Apps where you can connect to strangers and speak in English. You can check out on PlayStore or apple store. Note: Do not think that people will make fun of you! Even if they make its their problem, we are trying to improve, let them see after an year. Be determined! If someone tells you , you have a bad English and asks you to stop, just tell them Suyog forced you to speak, put the BLAME ON ME! but Never Stop! 3. Build your vocabulary : As per Michael Thomas, great linguist and a great language teacher, there are only 1500 words that newspapers use on daily basis. Make a habit of learning new words daily. Keep your notes handy and revisit the words whenever you have free time. 15 words a day and you will be perfect in 100 days (about 3 Months) 4. Watch English Contents: Start with simple cartoons and then gradually advance to Series and Movies. You might want to use subtitles at first and then gradually removing the subtitles off! I still use subtitles sometimes mostly when I watch any content of British accent. That’s just me. 5. Write : Make a journal, write a story , write here on Quora. There are many options available. Just put in the work. 6. Grammar : Grammar is very important, but when we are just starting out, do not focus much on grammar. Just try to move, and put in your work. There are many apps that will teach you English grammar. Main thing is that we should be able to communicate ourselves properly. How long will it take? I do not know, but with 1–2 hours of practice, one should be pretty comfortable with English in 2–3 Months. Anything to keep in mind? Do not ever lose hope. There are good days and there are bad days, we just have to keep our composure and move forward. Just put in your diligent efforts! Wishing you a good life. Regards, Suyog

Question: Is there a love age limit between a 15-year-old and a 21 year old?
Answer: No. Love doesn't come with any terms and conditions. Love doesn't come with any criteria. Loving means being fulfilled inside and sharing the content/happiness/compassion with others. Loving means giving, love is beautiful. And certainly there is no any love age limit between 15 y.o. & 21 y.o. Best wishes. Love ❤️
